remaining.title: Admit useful GPU work with live resource envelopes
remaining.exit: A bounded successful candidate is admitted when justified by fresh evidence; every unknown or unsafe case returns independently verified CPU bytes without repeated device searches. This is not proof of native compression speed.

remaining.title: Resolve intermittent hosted writer/child retirement failures
remaining.exit: The earlier failures are explained by captured evidence and a targeted regression; repeated isolated qualification confirms child exit and cleanup.

remaining.title: Connect qualified GPU work to native filesystem compression
remaining.exit: A native filesystem operation demonstrably uses GPU work with exact recovery and measured end-to-end benefit in stated conditions; otherwise retain CPU routing and record why.

remaining.title: Reduce GPU pipeline overhead while preserving containment
remaining.exit: Measured whole-operation gains survive the safety and correctness gates; no optimization depends on omitting integrity checks or unbounded persistent processes.

remaining.title: Scale the store and namespace with bounded incremental work
remaining.exit: Explicit scaling targets and measured resource bounds pass without merely increasing constants or abandoning recovery.

remaining.title: Persist bounded crash-safe optimization state
remaining.exit: A CPU-readable bounded optimization area survives the defined fault model without making data readability depend on a mutable learned model.

remaining.title: Discover capabilities and govern foreground/background resources
remaining.exit: The same OS/architecture runs without host-specific paths/specs; unknown headroom fails closed and background work obeys a documented bounded interference budget.

remaining.title: Select foreground compression from measured benefit
remaining.exit: Foreground policy improves the published throughput/reduction tradeoff over the fixed baseline on held-out workloads, with safe degradation under load.

remaining.title: Learn workload policies and run bounded idle microbenchmarks
remaining.exit: Learning persists safely and shows held-out benefit over simpler policies without changing correctness or consuming uncontrolled resources.

remaining.title: Collectively optimize cold data and layout
remaining.exit: Unattended collective optimization produces verified net gains without manual intervention, runaway rewrites or material foreground disruption.

remaining.title: Qualify payload repair and acknowledged-write durability
remaining.exit: The explicit fault model and acknowledgement contract pass independent recovery with no unexplained lost acknowledged bytes. Universal survival of arbitrary bugs or loss of all copies is not a claim.

remaining.title: Complete Windows semantics and helper/application lifecycle
remaining.exit: Published Windows capability matrix and reproducible client qualification cover the promised app/driver behaviors; hosted callback success alone is insufficient.

remaining.title: Security and independent comparative qualification
remaining.exit: Claims match reproducible evidence and unresolved blockers are disclosed. No selected result establishes universal superiority over every filesystem.

efficiency_rules: Read ledger and applicable AGENTS; verify current main/CI before trusting cached state.
Use exact paths/symbols and bounded excerpts; semantic routing receipts before new broad navigation; source confirmation required.
Batch independent native reads. Reuse immutable same-commit captures; refresh only changed/uncertain evidence.
One bounded design decision then implement/test; avoid repeated speculative replanning and unchanged status narration.
Inspect only failure/evidence log lines first; retain full native logs by job handle.
No cosmetic-only result push; fold executed-result ledger/doc updates into next substantive validated implementation.
Never save tokens by reducing tests, source research, safety/quality, or inventing evidence.
